question: Electrical current is measured by -
solution:
The correct answer is __Ammeter__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• An ammeter is an instrument for measuring either direct or alternating electric current, in amperes.
 
• An ammeter can measure a wide range of current values because at high values only a small portion of the current is directed through the meter mechanism.
